# Sapling

<a href="Item-sapling.md" title="Sapling"><img src="icons/97.png" width="96" height="96" alt="Sapling"></a>

A replantable young tree. Place it on dry grass or dirt to renew your wood supply.

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 64 |
| Placement | Place from the hotbar |

## How to obtain

Natural leaves have a 5% chance to drop one when destroyed or decayed after chopping a trunk. Mining or uprooting a planted sapling returns it.

## Using it

Use on dry grass or dirt. After about three minutes of unpaused world simulation, it can grow into a broadleaf tree with 4–6 logs. The complete footprint needs loaded, clear space and geometric skylight. Buildings, water, foliage and characters postpone growth. Save/load preserves its deadline; time outside the game adds no growth.

## Crafting and processing

There is no registered crafting or processing recipe for this item. Use the acquisition method above.
